messages:
Jordan: Hey — Jordan here, first day on infra. Quick access Q: when I click into Console > Feature Flags (staging) I get a 403. I signed in with SSO and I think I'm in the infra-engineers group. Who should I ping for the right role?

Priya: Welcome Jordan! :wave: You typically need either the platform-admin or the staging-ff-admin role for full flag admin in staging. @Sam or @Devon can check group provisioning.

Sam: @Jordan can you paste the exact error and the Console URL you tried? Also send your work email so I can look up SCIM provisioning.

Jordan: Error text: "You do not have permission to view this page (permission: flag-admin)". URL: https://console.staging.redwood.ai/flags. Email: jordan@redwood.ai

Sam: Thanks. Looks like your SCIM group membership didn't sync to the Console role mapping yet. I can add a JIT temporary role while we fix SCIM.

Jordan: Thanks — that'd help. I need to poke around toggles for onboarding tasks.

Devon: I'll run a manual SCIM sync and also add a 4h temporary staging-ff-admin role. Running: ```scimctl sync-user --email jordan@redwood.ai```

deploy-bot: role-manager: staging-ff-admin role applied to jordan@redwood.ai (expires in 4h).

Jordan: Confirmed — I can see the admin UI now and edit a toggle. Thanks!!

Priya: Nice. Quick tips for your first day: 1) Don't change any prod-facing rollouts, stick to staging. 2) Use the canary rollout option for any percentage changes. 3) Always add a short rollout note and @mention the owning product eng.

Sam: Also add the preview query param when testing toggle behavior, e.g. append `?preview=true` to the flag preview link so you don't impact real users. I'll also drop the onboarding doc in the thread in case you missed it.

Priya: onboarding doc: https://docs.internal/onboarding/console-feature-flags (has checklist + safe patterns).

Jordan: Perfect, bookmarking that. Appreciate the quick help everyone :tada:

Devon: If SCIM keeps failing, @Sam and I will open an infra ticket. For now you should be set. Ping here if anything weird pops up.
